entries.よぉ!びっくりしたかい?\n・・・オレは、カレハチョウを\n集めてるんだ・・・\:
Hey! Did I startle you?
...I'm collecting Leaf Butterflies...

Rumor has it Leaf Butterflies have
a mysterious power...

If you gather a few of them,
something amazing is supposed to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the Leaf Butterflies you've caught
in this bug cage.
entries.なんだ・・・もう\nもってたのか・・・: What... did you already have it...?
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今 匹ぐらいだな・・・:
One... two... three...
There are about   Leaf Butterflies now...
entries.・・・おりれなくなっちゃった\n\n花の種をさがしにきたんだけど・・・\nどこに:
...I can't get down.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nつれてってくれるの?\n・・・・・・ありがとう!:
...Older brother, will you take me with you?
...Thank you!
entries.・・・おにいちゃん、\nそっちじゃないとおもうよ:
...Big brother,
I don't think it's that way.
entries.いや・・・\nどこにもいない:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.
entries.やはり、\nただのウワサか?: Is it just a rumor after all?
entries.でも、このもりで\n見たドワーフいる:
But there is a Dwarf
I saw in this forest
entries.でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも\nこんなところまでぬけ道つくるのは、とても大変・・: But even for a great thief, creating a secret passage like this is incredibly difficult...
entries.・・・もういちど、\n地下ロウみにいく: ...I'm going to the underground prison again.
entries.・・・うわぁっ!!!\n・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・\nなんだ、いつかのガ:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...Boy, I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...
entries.い、いやぁ・・・\nやっと、ここから出してもらえてさぁ・・・\nけ、けっして ぬ:
W-well...
I was finally let out of here...
I d-didn't escape, I swear...
Well, I'll be going now...
entries.よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・\nどうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしな:
Hey... I've been waiting for you to come...
How about it? Want to have a match with me?
entries.じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに\nある宝をかくしておいたんだ\n\nそこ:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the top of the Watch Tower up ahead.

Here's the deal: start from the bottom of the Watch Tower,
and if you reach the treasure before I do,
it's yours...

How about it? Sounds fun, right?
entries.はぁ・・・はぁ・・・\nお前さん はやいなぁ・・・\n\nしょうがない、オレのま:
Haa... haa...
You're fast...

Can't be helped, I lose...
I'll give you that map...
entries.いやぁ、ひさしぶりに\nたのしかったゼ\n・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!: Wow, it was really fun after a long time... Well then, bye!
entries.どうやら、オレの\nかち みたいだな・・・: It seems like it's my victory...
entries.ん? なんだい、くやしそうなカオだな・・・\nまぁ、オレはどうせ ヒマだからな・:
Hmm? What's this, a frustrated-looking face...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again, feel free to talk to me anytime.
entries.よし! リトライだな・・・\nじゃあ、下におりようか・・・:
Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...
entries.あの犬、ケガしてるみたいで\nあそこからおりられないんだ:
That puppy looks hurt,
and it can't get down from there
entries.あの犬、\nもどってきちゃったね:
That puppy
has come back, hasn't it
entries.このさき嵐の山・・・\n\nいつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・\nわし、:
Beyond here is Storm Mountain...

A very dangerous mountain where a strong wind always blows...
The Elder told me to keep watch here...
...but it's awfully boring...

So I always practice here.
Eh? Practice for what?

......The truth is, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is really hard...
What kind of face should I make to move everyone...?
entries.おおっ!そのカオ、\nそのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!\n\n・・・なるほど:
Oh! That face, that expression... wonderful!!

...I see...
...hm-hm...
...mm, this is very helpful.
entries.・・・う〜ん\n・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・\n\nたとえば・・・\n人に:
...Hmm...
...but something's still missing...

For example...
what kind of face should I make
to convey sadness to people?...
entries.ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!\nそ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・\n・・・:
Huh?... Whoooa!
T-that face full of sorrow!...
...I see...

If I master that laughing face from before and that crying face now...
Hm-hm...
...Mmmmmm...

I see it!!
Yes! Thank you!!

Thanks to you, I feel like I'm onto something!
Oops, no time to lose.
...Time to start training!!
entries.おっと、わすれてた・・・\nさっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・\n\n何で:
Oops, I forgot...
The Elder just went off toward the mountain...

He seems to have business with you...
You'd better hurry.
entries.立ち入り禁止\nこの森には怪物がすんでいます。\n\nキケンですので立ち入らない:
No Entry
A monster lives in this forest.

It is dangerous, so please keep out
Baby Village Nature Management Bureau
entries.おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・\n花のナミダ、恵みさまの復活にかかせない・・・:
I came to get Flower Tears...
Flower Tears are essential for reviving the Megumi Fountain...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...
entries.○○○◎◎○◎◎・・・◎◎○○○\n●△○○・・・○○◎△○○?:
Gnee gnug glop... gnee gnug
gnu... gruf gnu?
entries.高見ヤグラの下のほう、\n木でできてるところ・・・\n\nこわれやすいから\n気:
The lower part of the Watch Tower,
the part made of wood...

It breaks easily,
so you'd better be careful...
entries.あの、まんなかにいるのが\n恵みコゾウさまたち・・・\nでも、うごかない・・・:
Those ones in the middle
are the Megumi Statues...
But they don't move...
entries.ココロあらわれるこのポーズ\n・・・うつくしい・・・: This pose that reveals the heart... beautiful...
entries.恵みさまが復活し、\n動きはじめるとき・・・\n何かがおこるといわれてる・・・:
When the Megumi Fountain revives
and begins to move...
they say something will happen...
entries.ここ、恵みの広場・・・\n魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、\nもっとキレイなところ・・:
This is Megumi Plaza...
If only the Evil Pig's magic were broken,
it would be a prettier place...
entries.キノコの森には\n怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・\n気をつけたほうがいい・・・:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the Mushroom Forest...
You should be careful...
entries.恵みさま・・・\nやっぱり動かない・・・:
The Megumi Fountain...
still doesn't move...
entries.そう言えば、恵みさまの\n動いてるところ・・・\nだれも見たことない・・・:
Come to think of it,
nobody has ever seen
the Megumi Fountain moving...
entries.わし、きょうは村の\n地下ロウの見はり当番・・・\n\nあれ?これ、\nないしょ:
Today I'm on guard duty at the village's
underground prison...

Huh? Wasn't this a secret??
entries.この森も、昔はキレイな花が\nいっぱい咲いてた・・・\nこれもみんな、魔ブタのせ:
This forest too used to be
full of beautiful flowers...
It's all the Evil Pigs' fault...
entries.魔ブタのかくれ家、\n目には見えないらしい・・・\n\nでも、入口は\nどこかに:
The Evil Pigs' hideout
apparently can't be seen...

But there must be an entrance
somewhere...
entries.ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・: This is... you already know, right?
entries.バッカスの湖にある水は、\nぜんぶアルコール・・・\n\nよっぱらうから、\n気:
The water in Bacchus Lake
is all alcohol...

You'll get drunk,
so you'd better be careful...
entries.恵みさまを復活させるには、\nなにかが必要らしい・・・\n\nえ〜と・・・\nど:
It seems you need something
to revive the Megumi Fountain...

Um...
I forgot...
entries.ん?・・・\n恵みさまを復活させるもの?\n\n・・・そういえば、なにかの\nな:
Hm?...
Something to revive the Megumi Fountain?

...Come to think of it,
some kind of tears are needed...
entries.恵みコゾウさま、\n人気者・・・みんな、\nこの広場にあつまってくる:
The Megumi Statues are
popular... everyone
gathers in this plaza
entries.嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が\nかかっているらしい・・・\n封印ぶくろ、どこかにある:
It seems the Evil Pigs' magic has been cast on Storm Mountain too...
There must be a Seal Bag somewhere...
entries.ときどき、森の地面の下から、\nものおとがきこえてくる・・・\nちょっとコワイ・:
Sometimes noises come from under the forest floor...
It's a little scary...
entries.わし、村の入口ちかくにある、\nへんならくがきと同じもの、\n怪物マンションで見:
Near the village entrance,
I found the same kind of
weird graffiti at Monster Mansion...
entries.この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、\nキノコの森を左に行けば、\n海辺がある・・:
Go through the Leaf Slider ahead
and take the Mushroom Forest to the left,
and you'll find the seaside...
entries.キノコの森のむこうがわには、\n赤ちゃん村とバッカスの湖がある・・・:
Beyond the Mushroom Forest
are Baby Village and Lake Bacchus...
entries.わしら、おまえに助けてもらった・・・\nだから、このタマゴおまえにやる・・・:
You helped us...
so I'll give you this egg...
entries.なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・\nここからさきは いかないほうがいい:
The companions... haven't been found...
You shouldn't go any further from here
entries.ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・\nもりのおくへ いかないように\nみはって:
A dwarf child got lost...
I'm keeping watch so no one goes
deeper into the forest...
entries.よぉ!びっくりしたかい?\n・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting Leaf Butterflies...
entries.ウワサによると、\nカレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・\n何匹か集めるとス:
According to the rumors,
Leaf Butterflies have a mysterious power...
If you gather a few of them, something amazing is supposed to happen...
entries.何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、\nつかまえた カレハチョウを\nこのムシカ:
If you want to see what happens,
put the Leaf Butterflies you've caught
in this bug cage
entries.ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・\nカレハチョウは今・・・\n00匹ぐらいだな・・:
Hii... fuu... mii...
Right now there are
about 00 Leaf Butterflies...
entries.今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。\nこの先のエリアに進むと\nゲームは自動的に:
This version ends here.
If you go on to the area ahead,
the game ends automatically.
entries.見えないカガミ?: The Mirror You Can't See In?
entries.地下ロウの大ドロボウ: The Great Thief of the Underground Prison
entries.◎○□□□・・・○○○◎△○○○●○○・・・: Glub grup... glop grug grub gruu...
entries.わし、けっこうアタマいい\nおまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、\nおまえ、ドワーフ:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your language... but
you don't know the Dwarf language...

If you bite a dwarf,
you can learn our language...
Once might not be enough, though...
entries.目のまえで、なかま\nいなくなった・・・:
Right before my eyes, my friend
disappeared...
entries.どうしちゃったのかねぇ\nいきなり 4人も いなくなったんだって?\n\nきっと:
What could have happened?
Four of them suddenly vanished, they say?

It must be that again
The Koma Buta must have hidden them
as a prank...
entries.しんぱいだけど・・・\nほら みんな ちいさいだろ?\n\n高いところや ホウシ:
I'm worried, but...
look, they're all small, right?

In high places or inside the spores
they can't reach...
entries.おやっ!\n・・・これ、くれるのかい?\nうれしいねぇ・・・\n\nそうだ、何か:
Oh!
...You're giving me this?
How nice...

Oh yes, I don't know what it is,
but please take this in return
entries.・・・ふうーーーっ・・・じつは、\nおなかの中にガスがたまってて\nくるしかった:
......Phew...... You see,
gas had built up in my belly
and it was awful

You've saved me......
Thank you......
I don't really understand it, but

......take this in return
......Apparently it's a rare thing
entries.この火、消さない・・・\nこれ わしのしごと・・・:
I won't let this fire go out...
This is my job...
entries.ん?なんだ、おまえ\nこれ欲しいのか?\n\n・・・火、あぶないから\nきをつけ:
Hm? What, you want this? ⏎

...Fire is dangerous,
so be careful carrying it...
entries.お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜\n・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights have gone out!
entries.こども!・・・こども見なかったか?\n\nこども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね\nさが:
Child!... Have you seen my child?

My child went to the Watch Tower to look for flower seeds
and hasn't come back!

I'm worried, so worried...
Terribly worried...
entries.・・・まだひとりも、\nかえってこない・・・: ...Not one of them has come back yet...
entries.しんぱい、しんぱい・・・\nとてもしんぱい・・・:
I'm worried, I'm worried...
I'm very worried...
entries.おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!\n\nおまえ、とてもやさしいこころもっ:
Oh! You rescued my child!

You have a very kind heart
...I'm very happy.

As thanks, take this — I'm sure it will help you.
entries.こども見つけてくれて\nありがとう・・・\nわしとおまえ、ともだち:
Thank you for finding my child...
You and I are friends.
entries.おにいちゃん、\n花のたね みつけたら\nおしえてね!: Hey, big brother, if you find flower seeds, let me know!
entries.この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・\n\nちょっと前までは、\n森にたくさんの:
I want to make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Until a little while ago,
there were lots of seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I get the feeling it isn't only the Evil Pigs' doing, though...
entries.もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・: I wonder if I'll never see flowers again...
entries.おまえ、APと書かれた\nへんなモノ見たか?: Did you see that weird thing with "AP" written on it?
entries.わしらのなかま、あれと同じ\nマークの入ったトビラや箱も\n見たこと、あるらしい:
Our friends say they've seen
doors and boxes marked
the same as that...
entries.どうすれば、ひらくか?\n・・・気になる・・・:
How do I open it?
...I'm curious...
entries.ドワーフ、\nとてもこまってる・・・:
The dwarves
are in great trouble...
entries.くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる\nなかまがしってる・・・:
My friends in the square
know the details...
entries.おお、おまえ、よくきてくれた!\nドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・\n\nじつは:
Oh, you, thank you for coming!
The Dwarves are in great trouble...

The truth is... this Dwarf Forest
is under the Evil Pig's magic...
The flowers withered and the trees changed shape...

Just now, four of our friends were taken by plants in the forest
and went missing...

Probably they're inside a spore bun
stuck on top of a pointed tree,

or caught by a hanging spore ball
and unable to move...

We've made it so no one can go deeper into the forest
until our friends are found...
Will you help our friends...?
entries.たぶん、なかまは とんがった木の上の\n ホウシまんじゅうの中か\n\nぶらさが:
Probably our friends are inside a spore bun
on top of a pointed tree,

or caught by a hanging spore ball
and unable to move...
entries.おお!\n\nおまえ・・・なかま、\nぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・\n\nほんと:
Oh!

You... you saved
all our friends...

Truly... thank you...
entries.こんかいのバージョンは、ここでおわり・・・\nおまえ、もっと プレイしたいなら\:
This version ends here...
If you want to play more,
please play the final version...

If you saved our friends,
this game will surely be fun for you...
All the Dwarves are waiting!!
entries.・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・\nじつは、こどもがひとり・・・\n森:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...
entries.おまえ、とても、ゆうきある\nドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする:
You are very brave.
Dwarf respects you.
entries.勇気ある少年よ・・・\nわしがドワーフの\n長老ですじゃ・・・:
Brave boy...
I am the Elder
of the Dwarves...
entries.7人のドワーフは\nかえってきたんじゃが・・・\n\n子どもがまだ\nかえってこ:
The seven dwarves have come back,
but...

the child still
hasn't come back...
entries.子どもの父親は、この集落の\n入口のちかくの家におる・・・\n話をきいてくれんか:
The child's parents are in the house
near the entrance of this settlement...
Won't you go and listen to them?
entries.村人全員になりかわり、\n礼を言わせてほしい・・・\n\nなかまをたすけてくれて:
On behalf of all the villagers,
allow me to thank you...

Thank you so much
for helping our friends...

It's such a small village that
we can't offer you much of a reward...

...Oh, that's right...
I heard from the 100-Year-Old Man,

that you're chasing after the Evil Pigs...
entries.おぉ、あったあった、\nこれじゃ・・・:
Ah, here it is,
here it is...
entries.これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの\n封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・\n\nこれが:
This is the Seal Bag of the Evil Pig
who cast the spell on this forest...

With this, just by approaching
where an Evil Pig is hiding,
it should find the entrance to the hideout —
the Evil Pig Gate — for you...
entries.でも、魔ブタ、\n自分が魔法をかけた場所には\nかくれない・・・:
But the Evil Pig
never hides in a place
it has cast its magic on...
entries.それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、\n1匹づつ封印できる\n\:
Also, each Evil Pig has its own Seal Bag,
and you can seal them one at a time.

...In other words, seven Evil Pigs
need seven Seal Bags.
entries.ふくろ、\n魔法をかけられた場所の\nちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・:
The bags should surely be
near the places where the magic was cast...
entries.魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、\nそれぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが\n一:
If you want to know where the Evil Pigs are,
finding each Seal Bag
is the quickest way...

But... the Evil Pigs' power is mighty...
Don't push yourself too hard...

There's no need to guard the back of the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.もう、森のおくを\n見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・\n自由に通ってくだされ・・・:
There's no need to guard
the back of the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...
entries.魔ブタ・・・\n自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・\n\n封印ぶくろあれ:
The Evil Pigs...
never hide in places they cast magic on...

With a Seal Bag,
you can find the Evil Pig Gate...

But each Evil Pig has its own Seal Bag,
and you can seal them one at a time...

In other words, seven Evil Pigs
need seven Seal Bags...

The bags are sure to be
near the places where the magic was cast...
entries.ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・\n\nおまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・\nだか:
Dwarves are good at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you're ever in trouble,
ask one of our friends...
entries.ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?\n\nでも、ドワーフが切るのは\nやくめをおえた:
Hm... you want a tree cut down?

But dwarves only cut old trees
that have finished their purpose...

Anyway, I'll follow you...
entries.・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・\nじゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・:
...Yes, this tree is fine...
Then stand back a little and wait...
entries.おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?\nこまったねぇ・・・\n\n実は、村のド:
Oh, are you looking for the Elder too?
What a problem...

Actually, two Dwarves of the village
started fighting...
Normally I'd leave them be, but...

Of all places they're scuffling at the village entrance,
so nobody can get outside...

......Could you stop them?
entries.長老がいたら、\n一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・:
If only the Elder were here,
he'd settle it in one go...
entries.うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!\n\nそんなの すぐに見つかる・・・\n\:
I hid it well, so it's fine!

Something like that will be found right away...

No, I should apologize after all!
entries.あの2人、長老から\n何かあずかってたらしい・・・: It seems those two received something from Elder...
entries.ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!\n\nおまえがわるい!\n\nいや、こわした:
S-see... I knew it would be found!

It's your fault!

No, you're the one who broke it!
entries.ぶわっかもーん!!\nわしの大事なつぼを\nこわすとはなにごとゃ!:
You fool!!
What do you mean by breaking
my precious pot!
entries.ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・\nおまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといて:
Phew... I finally managed to escape from this hole...
Sorry, but could you please fill this hole back in?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
While we're at it... could you go take a look?
entries.ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、\nいちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、\:
Phew... since you took so long to come,
I came back to the village once,
and fell right into this hole...

I finally got out of the hole...

...Sorry, but could you
fill in this hole for me?

...But who on earth dug such a hole...

I'll be waiting up on the mountain again...
Don't keep an old man waiting too long...
entries.・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!\nぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!\n\n・・:
......Ah! You!
Aren't you the kid who blocked the secret passage!

......Geez......
I was trying to slip away while the Koma Buta weren't looking,
and you blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that,
I'm back in the dungeon again...
entries.これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか\nパン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・\n\nくそっ:
At this rate I can't steal even a slice of bread,
let alone the mansion's treasure...

Damn it, I'm going to sulk and sleep!
entries.おや、かわいいボウヤだね。\nでも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・\n\nわた:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But you look healthy enough, don't you...

I may not look it, but I'm a doctor,
so if you get hurt, come again.
entries.ボウヤ・・・\nわたしゃこう見えても\nいそがしいんだよ・・・:
Boy...
I know I don't look it,
but I'm busy...
entries.みんなを助けてくれたんだって?\nけっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね:
You helped everyone, didn't you?
You're pretty good at this... Thanks.
entries.あんたがケガしたら\nまっ先に見てあげるからね:
If you get hurt,
I'll see to you first.
entries.おや、どうしたんだいその小犬・・・\nケガしてるじゃないか!\nちょっと見せてご:
Oh, what's wrong with that puppy...
It's hurt!
Let me have a look.

..........
...This looks like it will take a while...

Boy, I'll look after this puppy for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take responsibility for it.

...Oh, what's this puppy's name?
....?
Come on... you could at least give it a name...

......Baron?... I see, Baron.
...That's a good name!
entries.しばらくしたら また、\n見に来ておくれ:
Come and see us again
in a while.
entries.おまえ、森の外出るのか?\nだったら一度、海辺行ってみるといい\n\nとてもキレ:
You, going outside the forest?
Then go to the seashore once

Very pretty... you can see a big mansion far away
Rumor says there is treasure too...
You, brave. If interested, go and see
entries.・・・そういえば、むかし、\n海からこのむらに、魔女きたことある・・・\n\n森:
......Come to think of it, long ago,
a witch came to this village from the sea......

The mysterious crystals in the forest are the Witch's forgotten things......
Probably the Witch knows how to open them......
entries.おまえ、ともだち・・・\nまたあそびにこい:
You, my friend...
Come play again.
entries.おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!\n・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!:
Big brother! Big brother!
...The flowers have bloomed!
entries.○○○、□□□□○◎・・・○○、\n○△○○○○○○:
Gnock, grug grub... gnu,
grub gruu glub
entries.○○○、○△○○○・・・\n○○○○○△○○○●・・・:
Gnock, gnub gnock...
gnug glop grug...
entries.そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に\nつな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?:
Gruu glub grup... grup
gnock gnee... gnug glop?
entries.◎●、へ○な□□◎た\n・・・お○え◎たか?:
In the forest, I saw a strange dog...
Did you see it?
entries.な○まの○と・・・とても○ん◎い:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.な○まの○と・・・\nと○も○ん◎い:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.森の中、とてもあぶない\n・・・ぜったいダメ!:
It's very dangerous in the forest
...absolutely not!
entries.そこの右側の入口・・・\n長老の家につながってる\n\n・・・でも、今みんな\n:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It's connected to Elder's house.

...But everyone's busy right now...
entries.おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・\nでも、まだ かんぜんには わからない\:
Oh! You've learned a little of our language...
But I still don't understand you completely.

...If you bite one more,
you can probably learn the language...
entries.ここ、ドワーフの村\n・・・なかまいなくなって\nおおさわぎ・・・:
This is the Dwarf Village...
our friends have gone missing,
and it's a big uproar...
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\nなかま、いなくなった!\n\n森にある小屋はとじてあるか:
Oh no! Oh no!
Our friends are gone!

The hut in the forest is shut,
so our friends must be
somewhere in this forest...
entries.なかま、木にとりついた\nホウシにつかまって\n木にぶらさがってた・・・\n\n:
A friend was caught by a spore
that attached itself to a tree,
and was hanging from the tree...

The Spore Balls stretch when you hang from them
...very suspicious...
entries.このへんなキカイ、\n昔からここにある・・・\nわしらには動かせない・・・:
This strange machine
has been here since long ago......
We can't move it......
entries.わし・・・長老のいちばんでし: I... am the Elder's top disciple
entries.なかまのこと・・・\nとてもしんぱい:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.
entries.たいへん!たいへん!\n何がたいへんって、\nそりゃーもーたいへん!:
Terrible! Terrible!
What's so terrible?
It's just awfully terrible!
entries.封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、\n森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの\nちょうろうがもっ:
Seal Bag?... Come to think of it,
the Elder has something called
the Forest Seal Bag...
entries.おまえ、友だち・・・\nまぁ、ゆっくりしていけ:
You, friend...
Well, make yourself at home.
entries.かれはのなかに\nかわったチョウチョがいるらしい・・・\n\nおまえ見たこと あ:
There's apparently a strange butterfly
among the dead leaves...

Have you ever seen it?
entries.あのイヌ、\nケガしてたんだってな・・・: I heard that dog was injured...
entries.ぶらさがっている まるい\nホウシダマ 見なかったか?:
Did you see a round, hanging
spore ball?
entries.森の中にある恵みの広場\n・・・もう行ったか?:
The Megumi Plaza in the forest
......Have you been there yet?
entries.なかまのこと\nとてもしんぱい:
I'm so worried
about our friends
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・ん?何の見はりか?\n・・・・・それはおしえられない・・・:
I...... watch...... Hm? Watching what?
......That I cannot tell you......
entries.長老にはもうあったか?: Have you met the Elder yet?
entries.そう言えば・・・\n始まりの森のかみつき草にも\n花が咲くらしい・・・\n\nで:
Speaking of which...
they say flowers bloom on the Biting Grass
in the Forest of Beginnings too...

But we've never seen it...
entries.キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に\n山がある・・・でも、\nとてもキケンな山・・・:
Beyond the Mushroom Forest, to the right,
there's a mountain... but
it's a very dangerous mountain...
entries.キノコの森には、\nいろんなキノコはえてるけど\nむやみに食べない方がいい: There are various mushrooms growing in the Mushroom Forest, but you shouldn't eat them recklessly.
entries.高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?\nあそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・:
Have you seen the Watch Tower's telescope yet?
The view from there is really beautiful...
entries.このキカイこわれてる・・・\n\nたまに来る、赤い服をきたヤツなら\nなおせるか:
This machine is broken......

Someone who comes by sometimes, in red clothes,
might be able to fix it
entries.わし・・・見はり・・・\nちょっとたいへん・・・:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...
entries.わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・\n◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・:
Gnu gnub, gnock gnee...
grup gruf gnu gnub...
entries.わしらの◎◎にはもう◎△たか?: Have you met our Elder yet?
entries.わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・\n今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・:
Our comrades have disappeared...
It's better not to go into the forest now...
entries.わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?: Have you met our Elder yet?
entries.たき火といえば・・・\n・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・\n\nそういえば、\n:
Speaking of bonfires...
...it's baked sweet potatoes, isn't it...

Come to think of it, there's a nice smell in the forest...
entries.ケガしてるね・・・\nかわいそう・・・:
You're hurt, aren't you...
Poor thing...
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?:
Have you checked all the spore buns
hanging from the pointed trees?
entries.とがった木にぶら下がっている\nホウシまんじゅうの中に\nなかま2人 とりこまれ:
Two friends got caught
in the spore buns
hanging from the pointed trees
entries.ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・\nとてもあやしい・・・:
The swaying Spore Balls...
very suspicious...
entries.ホウシダマがかぶさっている\n木の上のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・:
There should be two friends
up in the trees covered by Spore Balls...
entries.グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり\nつかまってた・・・:
One friend was caught
at Wobbly Pier...
entries.高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん\n・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・\n回復する板:
The Watch Tower...... is wide and hard
......hard to find friends......
If you don't use the healing boards well......
entries.たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま\nつかまっているハズ: I think there are two companions trapped in Watch Tower.
entries.奥のカベには ↑と×ボタンで とびつくことができ、\nそのまま上に上がると 奥の: You can jump onto the wall in the back with ↑ and the × button, and if you keep going up you can walk along the back line. To come back to the front, do the opposite.
entries.木の枝にぶら下がったときは→で回転\nどんどん速くなる。ジャンプしたい\n方向と: When you hang from a tree branch, press → to spin. You go faster and faster. Press the direction you want to jump and the × button to launch yourself off!
entries.○ボタンをおしつづけると、\nより強力な攻撃ができる: Hold down the ○ button for a more powerful attack.
entries.人と話すときは ○ボタン: When talking to people, press the ○ button.
entries.ここがセーブポイントです。\n↑で奥を向いているときに\n○を押せばセーブができ: This is a save point. Face into the screen with ↑ and press ○ to save.
entries.この土地は はじめてか?\n\nオレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、\nなんか:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!
entries.よぉ、にィちゃんも\nこの先に行きたいのかい?\n\nそりゃぁムリだ・・・\nこ:
Hey, you want to go on up ahead too, pal?

That's impossible... It's pure white with fog up there.

If the fog cleared you could go, but...
entries.まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば\n何とかなるみたいだけど・・・\:
From what I hear, if you had a Rampaging Tornado you could manage somehow...
But where on earth would a thing like that be...?

I gave up!
You'd better think about it too, pal...

So long!
entries.オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ\n何か たべるもん ないか?・・・\:
I'm starving and in a foul mood right now.
Got anything to eat?...
If not, come back later.
entries.オ〜〜〜ッ!\nなんだ それくれるのか?\n\nサンキュー! たすかったゼ\nも:
Ohhh!
What, you're giving me that?

Thanks! You saved me!
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa. Nice to meet you.
entries.そうだ!!\nとっておきの技をおしえてやるョ\n\nいいか?:
That's it!!
I'll teach you a special move.

Ready?
entries.□ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、\n人よんで ケモノダッシュってい:
Run while holding the □ button and you go faster.
It's a move people call the Beast Dash.
entries.おぼえたか?\n□ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・\nじゃぁオレはいくゼ\n\:
Got it?
Remember, hold the □ button......
Well, I'm off.

So long!
entries.・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!\n\nかくれてたんだけど よくわかった:
...Aw... you found me already!

I was hiding, and you still figured it out...
entries.よし! いいことおしえてやるよ\n\nこの小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるい:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

Go straight back behind this hut and you'll come to the Old Pond,
and if you go up past this hut,
an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there.
entries.え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・\nそんなことより まず行ってみろよ、\nウソ:
Huh? ...Me?...
Never mind that, go and see for yourself first,
I'm not lying...

We'll meet again after that.
entries.えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・: What?! You've already been there?... I see...
entries.100年老人には会ったのかい?\n\n会ったら また会おうや:
Have you met the 100-Year-Old Man?

Once you have, come see me again.
entries.ふるいけ には行ったかい?\n\n行ったら また会おうや:
Have you been to the Old Pond?

Once you have, come see me again.
entries.どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ\n\nじまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってん:
See, I wasn't lying, was I?

Not to brag, but I know all kinds of things.
entries.・・・あぁ、オイラかい?\n\nオイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・:
...Oh, me?

I'm Yan. Yan of the Hidden Village...
entries.いつも かくれてるんだけど、\nだれも見つけられないんだ・・・\n\nまた見つけ:
I'm always hiding, but nobody can ever find me...

If you find me again, I'll tell you something good then too!
...If you can find me, that is.
entries.う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・\nがんばって見つけてくれよ\n\n:
Hmm... this is starting to be fun...
Do your best to find me!

See ya!
entries.この先に行く気か?\n\nでも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?:
You're thinking of going on ahead?

But... can you swim?
entries.いかん、いかん\n\n今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが\n次からそうはいかん\:
No, no.

A turtle helped you this time, but it won't go like that next time.

You can't go past that door unless you can swim, so...

I'm not saying this to be mean, but you'd better not go now...

Go when you've learned to swim someday, all right?

Oh, right!
Aren't you hungry?

Take this!
entries.じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや: See you, kid. Be careful out there.
entries.・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・\n\nどーしたもんかのォ・・・\n\nんっ:
...Hmm... what a problem...

Whatever shall I do...

Oh?
entries.なんじゃ?・・・\nわしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?:
What is it?...
I'm the 100-Year-Old Man... Do you need something?
entries.すまんが、ちょっと\n考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・\n\n・・・おお そう:
Sorry, I was lost in thought...

...Oh, that's right!!
Would you do me a favor?
The favor is, you see...

You must have seen it on your way here —
that red bird, Kokka...

It steals eggs from other places
and keeps them as its own...

Left like that,
the chicks inside will suffer...

So, would you gather all the chicks from the eggs around here?
entries.しんぱいじゃからな・・・\nたのんだぞ:
I'm worried about them...
I'm counting on you.
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?\n\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\nじゃが まだ残っとる:
What, you've already collected them?

Hmmmm...
But it seems some are still left...

Sorry, but could you go once more?
entries.集めてくれたのか?・・・\nん〜〜〜っ・・・\n\nじゃが まだ残っとるようじゃ:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmmmm...

But it seems there are still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?
entries.なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・\nおおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではな:
What, they've already been gathered...?
Oh my! And you even got all of them!
......But where are the chicks?
entries.おー・まい・がっ!!\n\nハラの中に入れとったのか!?\n\nまぁ、しかし 消:
Oh... my... god!!

You kept them in your stomach!?

Well, they don't seem to have been digested, so I suppose it's fine...

Anyway, thank you for your trouble.
...Now I can rest easy.

Hm?... Oh yes, yes.
You seem to have had some business with me.

......Hoh......
The Koma Buta took your grandfather's keepsake bracelet...?

So you want to ask about the Koma Buta...

Hm, I see...
The truth is...
entries.集めてくれたのか?\n\n・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな\n・・・・・:
Did you collect them?

...Oh!! It seems you've gathered them all.
......But where are the chicks?
entries.わしが話してやれる事はここまでじゃ・・・\n\nもしおまえさんがこの先の道を進む:
That's as far as I can tell you...

If you go on down the road ahead,
try looking for my friends.
They're sure to help you...
entries.もちろん、わしの力になれることじゃったら\n何でも協力してやるからの・・・\n\:
Of course, anything I can do to help,
I'll gladly lend a hand...

...That's right,

I have a good eye for things,
so if you get something
you don't know how to use,
bring it to me...
entries.おや?ないのぉ・・・\nおまえさんに100年のすずを\nやろうとおもったんじゃが:
Oh? It's gone...
I meant to give you the 100-Year Bell,
but...

It seems I lost it somewhere...

If you find something that looks like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this...
Here, take this — the 100-Year Key.
entries.これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら\nあけることができるようになったはずじゃ・:
With this, you should now be able to open treasure chests just like the ones here...
Hmm, what luck...
entries.それと・・・魔ブタをさがすには、\n封印ぶくろ と呼ばれるモノが必要じゃ・・・\:
And... to find the Evil Pigs,
you'll need something called a Seal Bag...

Without it,
their hiding places can't be seen...
entries.封印ぶくろのことは、この先の森に住む\nドワーフの長老にきいてみるといい・・・\:
As for the Seal Bag, ask the Dwarf Elder
who lives in the forest ahead...
He should be able to tell you more.
entries.なんじゃ、わからない物があるなら見せてごらん・・・: What's this? If there's something you don't understand, show it to me...
entries.・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!\nよく見つけたのぉ・・・\n\nこ:
...Oh, this is indeed the 100-Year Bell!
Well done finding it...

If you use this,
you should be able to come back here any time...
entries.カエル水にかえる: The frog returns to the water.

Hey! Did I startle you?
...I'm collecting Leaf Butterflies...

Rumor has it Leaf Butterflies have
a mysterious power...

If you gather a few of them,
something amazing is supposed to happen...

If you want to see what happens,
put the Leaf Butterflies you've caught
in this bug cage.

messages.original:
なんだ・・・もう
もってたのか・・・
messages.translation: What... did you already have it...?

messages.original:
ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今  匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
One... two... three...
There are about   Leaf Butterflies now...

messages.original:
ん?・・・やけに
さわがしいなぁ・・・
な!?…何だ、何だ?

う・・・ うわーーーっ!

たすけてーーーっ!!

・・・おりれなくなっちゃった

花の種をさがしにきたんだけど・・・
どこにもないんだ・・・

かえりたいよぉ・・・
messages.translation:
...I can't get down.

I came looking for flower seeds, but...
I can't find any anywhere...

I want to go home...

messages.original:
・・・おにいちゃん、
つれてってくれるの?
・・・・・・ありがとう!
messages.translation:
...Older brother, will you take me with you?
...Thank you!

messages.original:
・・・おにいちゃん、
そっちじゃないとおもうよ
messages.translation:
...Big brother,
I don't think it's that way.

messages.original: いたか?

いや・・・
どこにもいない
messages.translation:
No...
He's nowhere to be found.

messages.original:
やはり、
ただのウワサか?
messages.translation: Is it just a rumor after all?

messages.original:
いや、それ
わからない・・・

でも、このもりで
見たドワーフいる
messages.translation:
But there is a Dwarf
I saw in this forest

messages.original:
でも、いくら 大ドロボウでも
こんなところまでぬけ道つくるのは、とても大変・・・
messages.translation: But even for a great thief, creating a secret passage like this is incredibly difficult...

messages.original:
・・・もういちど、
地下ロウみにいく
messages.translation: ...I'm going to the underground prison again.

messages.original:
・・・うわぁっ!!!
・・・び・・・びっくりしたぁ・・・
なんだ、いつかのガキか・・・
messages.translation:
...Whoa!!!
...B-...Boy, I was startled...
Oh, it's that kid from before...

messages.original:
い、いやぁ・・・
やっと、ここから出してもらえてさぁ・・・
け、けっして ぬけ出したわけじゃないぞ・・・
じゃぁ、オレはこれで・・・
messages.translation:
W-well...
I was finally let out of here...
I d-didn't escape, I swear...
Well, I'll be going now...

messages.original:
よぉ・・・お前のくるのをまってたんだ・・・
どうだい?オレと ひとしょうぶしないか?
messages.translation:
Hey... I've been waiting for you to come...
How about it? Want to have a match with me?

messages.original:
じつは、この先の高見ヤグラのてっぺんに
ある宝をかくしておいたんだ

そこでだ、高見ヤグラの下からスタートして、
オレより早く宝にたどりついたら
その宝はお前にやるよ・・・

どうだい、おもしろそうだろう?
messages.translation:
Actually, I've hidden a treasure at the top of the Watch Tower up ahead.

Here's the deal: start from the bottom of the Watch Tower,
and if you reach the treasure before I do,
it's yours...

How about it? Sounds fun, right?

messages.original: じゃ・・・いくゼ!
よーい・・・どん!

はぁ・・・はぁ・・・
お前さん はやいなぁ・・・

しょうがない、オレのまけだ・・・
その地図はお前さんにやるよ・・・
messages.translation:
Haa... haa...
You're fast...

Can't be helped, I lose...
I'll give you that map...

messages.original:
いやぁ、ひさしぶりに
たのしかったゼ
・・・じゃあ、アバヨ!
messages.translation: Wow, it was really fun after a long time... Well then, bye!

messages.original:
どうやら、オレの
かち みたいだな・・・
messages.translation: It seems like it's my victory...

messages.original:
ん? なんだい、くやしそうなカオだな・・・
まぁ、オレはどうせ ヒマだからな・・・

もう一度チャレンジしたくなったら、
いつでもオレに はなしかけてくれ
messages.translation:
Hmm? What's this, a frustrated-looking face...
Well, I'm just bored anyway...

If you ever want to try again, feel free to talk to me anytime.

messages.original:
よし! リトライだな・・・
じゃあ、下におりようか・・・
messages.translation:
Alright! Time for a retry...
Well then, let's go down...

messages.original:
あの犬、ケガしてるみたいで
あそこからおりられないんだ
messages.translation:
That puppy looks hurt,
and it can't get down from there

messages.original:
あの犬、
もどってきちゃったね
messages.translation:
That puppy
has come back, hasn't it

messages.original: この犬 ケガしてるね・・・

このさき嵐の山・・・

いつもつよい風ふく とてもきけんな山・・・
わし、長老にいわれて ここ、見はってる・・・
・・・けど、とてもたいくつ・・・

だから、いつもここで れんしゅうしてる
えっ?何のれんしゅうか?

・・・・・・じつは、わし役者になるのがゆめ・・・
役者になって、みんなを笑わせたり、
泣かせたり してみたい・・・

でも、れんしゅう とてもたいへん・・・
どんなカオすれば みんなかんどうするのか・・・
messages.translation:
Beyond here is Storm Mountain...

A very dangerous mountain where a strong wind always blows...
The Elder told me to keep watch here...
...but it's awfully boring...

So I always practice here.
Eh? Practice for what?

......The truth is, my dream is to become an actor...
I want to become an actor and make everyone laugh,
or cry...

But practice is really hard...
What kind of face should I make to move everyone...?

messages.original:
おおっ!そのカオ、
そのひょうじょう・・・とてもいい!!

・・・なるほど
・・・ふむふむ
・・・んーとても さんこうになる
messages.translation:
Oh! That face, that expression... wonderful!!

...I see...
...hm-hm...
...mm, this is very helpful.

messages.original:
・・・う〜ん
・・・でも、まだ何か足りない・・・

たとえば・・・
人に かなしみをつたえるには
どんなカオすればいいのか?・・・
messages.translation:
...Hmm...
...but something's still missing...

For example...
what kind of face should I make
to convey sadness to people?...

messages.original:
ん?・・・うおおぉぉぉっ!
そ、その あいしゅうにみちたカオ!・・・
・・・そうか・・・

さっきの笑がおと、いまの泣きがおをマスターして・・・
ふむふむ・・・
・・・んーーーーーーっ

見えた!!
うん!ありがとう!! 

キミのおかげで何かつかめそうな気がする!
おっと、こうしちゃいられない
・・・今から とっくんだ!!
messages.translation:
Huh?... Whoooa!
T-that face full of sorrow!...
...I see...

If I master that laughing face from before and that crying face now...
Hm-hm...
...Mmmmmm...

I see it!!
Yes! Thank you!!

Thanks to you, I feel like I'm onto something!
Oops, no time to lose.
...Time to start training!!

messages.original:
おっと、わすれてた・・・
さっき、長老、山の方へ入っていった・・・

何でも、キミに用があるらしい・・・
はやく行ったほうがいいよ
messages.translation:
Oops, I forgot...
The Elder just went off toward the mountain...

He seems to have business with you...
You'd better hurry.

messages.original:
立ち入り禁止
この森には怪物がすんでいます。

キケンですので立ち入らないで下さい
赤ちゃん村しぜんかんりきょく
messages.translation:
No Entry
A monster lives in this forest.

It is dangerous, so please keep out
Baby Village Nature Management Bureau

messages.original:
おれ、花のナミダとりに来た・・・
花のナミダ、恵みさまの復活にかかせない・・・

でも・・・
どうやってナミダ、集めるのかわからない・・・
messages.translation:
I came to get Flower Tears...
Flower Tears are essential for reviving the Megumi Fountain...

But...
I don't know how to collect the tears...

messages.original: ・・・こまった・・・

messages.translation:
Gnee gnug glop... gnee gnug
gnu... gruf gnu?

messages.original: ここ、恵みの広場・・・

高見ヤグラの下のほう、
木でできてるところ・・・

こわれやすいから
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
The lower part of the Watch Tower,
the part made of wood...

It breaks easily,
so you'd better be careful...

messages.original:
あの、まんなかにいるのが
恵みコゾウさまたち・・・
でも、うごかない・・・
messages.translation:
Those ones in the middle
are the Megumi Statues...
But they don't move...

messages.original:
ココロあらわれるこのポーズ
・・・うつくしい・・・
messages.translation: This pose that reveals the heart... beautiful...

messages.original:
恵みさまが復活し、
動きはじめるとき・・・
何かがおこるといわれてる・・・
messages.translation:
When the Megumi Fountain revives
and begins to move...
they say something will happen...

messages.original:
ここ、恵みの広場・・・
魔ブタの魔法さえとければ、
もっとキレイなところ・・・
messages.translation:
This is Megumi Plaza...
If only the Evil Pig's magic were broken,
it would be a prettier place...

messages.original:
キノコの森には
怪物がすんでるというウワサ・・・
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
There's a rumor that a monster lives in the Mushroom Forest...
You should be careful...

messages.original:
恵みさま・・・
やっぱり動かない・・・
messages.translation:
The Megumi Fountain...
still doesn't move...

messages.original:
そう言えば、恵みさまの
動いてるところ・・・
だれも見たことない・・・
messages.translation:
Come to think of it,
nobody has ever seen
the Megumi Fountain moving...

messages.original:
わし、きょうは村の
地下ロウの見はり当番・・・

あれ?これ、
ないしょだったっけ??
messages.translation:
Today I'm on guard duty at the village's
underground prison...

Huh? Wasn't this a secret??

messages.original:
この森も、昔はキレイな花が
いっぱい咲いてた・・・
これもみんな、魔ブタのせい・・・
messages.translation:
This forest too used to be
full of beautiful flowers...
It's all the Evil Pigs' fault...

messages.original:
魔ブタのかくれ家、
目には見えないらしい・・・

でも、入口は
どこかにあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The Evil Pigs' hideout
apparently can't be seen...

But there must be an entrance
somewhere...

messages.original: ここは・・・もう知ってるよね・・・
messages.translation: This is... you already know, right?

messages.original:
バッカスの湖にある水は、
ぜんぶアルコール・・・

よっぱらうから、
気をつけたほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
The water in Bacchus Lake
is all alcohol...

You'll get drunk,
so you'd better be careful...

messages.original:
恵みさまを復活させるには、
なにかが必要らしい・・・

え〜と・・・
どわすれした・・・
messages.translation:
It seems you need something
to revive the Megumi Fountain...

Um...
I forgot...

messages.original:
ん?・・・
恵みさまを復活させるもの?

・・・そういえば、なにかの
なみだが必要とか・・・
messages.translation:
Hm?...
Something to revive the Megumi Fountain?

...Come to think of it,
some kind of tears are needed...

messages.original:
恵みコゾウさま、
人気者・・・みんな、
この広場にあつまってくる
messages.translation:
The Megumi Statues are
popular... everyone
gathers in this plaza

messages.original:
嵐の山にも魔ブタの魔法が
かかっているらしい・・・
封印ぶくろ、どこかにあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
It seems the Evil Pigs' magic has been cast on Storm Mountain too...
There must be a Seal Bag somewhere...

messages.original:
ときどき、森の地面の下から、
ものおとがきこえてくる・・・
ちょっとコワイ・・・
messages.translation:
Sometimes noises come from under the forest floor...
It's a little scary...

messages.original:
わし、村の入口ちかくにある、
へんならくがきと同じもの、
怪物マンションで見つけた・・・
messages.translation:
Near the village entrance,
I found the same kind of
weird graffiti at Monster Mansion...

messages.original:
この先のリーフスライダーをぬけて、
キノコの森を左に行けば、
海辺がある・・・
messages.translation:
Go through the Leaf Slider ahead
and take the Mushroom Forest to the left,
and you'll find the seaside...

messages.original:
キノコの森のむこうがわには、
赤ちゃん村とバッカスの湖がある・・・
messages.translation:
Beyond the Mushroom Forest
are Baby Village and Lake Bacchus...

messages.original:
わしら、おまえに助けてもらった・・・
だから、このタマゴおまえにやる・・・
messages.translation:
You helped us...
so I'll give you this egg...

messages.original:
なかま・・・みつかっていない・・・
ここからさきは いかないほうがいい
messages.translation:
The companions... haven't been found...
You shouldn't go any further from here

messages.original:
ドワーフのこども 迷子になった・・・
もりのおくへ いかないように
みはってる・・・
messages.translation:
A dwarf child got lost...
I'm keeping watch so no one goes
deeper into the forest...

messages.original:
よぉ!びっくりしたかい?
・・・オレは、カレハチョウを集めてるんだ・・・
messages.translation:
Hey! Were you surprised?
...I'm collecting Leaf Butterflies...

messages.original:
ウワサによると、
カレハチョウにはふしぎな力があって・・・
何匹か集めるとスゴイことがおこるらしいゼ・・・
messages.translation:
According to the rumors,
Leaf Butterflies have a mysterious power...
If you gather a few of them, something amazing is supposed to happen...

messages.original:
何がおこるか、もし見たいんだったら、
つかまえた カレハチョウを
このムシカゴの中に入れてくれよ
messages.translation:
If you want to see what happens,
put the Leaf Butterflies you've caught
in this bug cage

messages.original:
なんだ・・・
もうもってたのか・・・

ひぃ・・・ふぅ・・・みぃ・・・
カレハチョウは今・・・
00匹ぐらいだな・・・
messages.translation:
Hii... fuu... mii...
Right now there are
about 00 Leaf Butterflies...

messages.original:
今回のバージョンは、ここまでです。
この先のエリアに進むと
ゲームは自動的に終了します。
messages.translation:
This version ends here.
If you go on to the area ahead,
the game ends automatically.

messages.translation: Glub grup... glop grug grub gruu...

わし、けっこうアタマいい
おまえのコトバわかる・・・けど、
おまえ、ドワーフのコトバ知らない・・・

わしらのコトバ、ドワーフにかみつけば
おぼえられる・・・
いっかいじゃ ダメかもしれないけど・・・
messages.translation:
I'm pretty smart.
I understand your language... but
you don't know the Dwarf language...

If you bite a dwarf,
you can learn our language...
Once might not be enough, though...

messages.original:
◎のまえ●、◎◎
いなくな△た・・・

な○とか ひ△しで
◎●てきた・・・

目のまえで、なかま
いなくなった・・・
messages.translation:
Right before my eyes, my friend
disappeared...

messages.original:
なんとか ひっしで
にげてきた・・・

どうしちゃったのかねぇ
いきなり 4人も いなくなったんだって?

きっと あれだね
また コマブタたちが いたずらで
かくしちまったんだろうねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
What could have happened?
Four of them suddenly vanished, they say?

It must be that again
The Koma Buta must have hidden them
as a prank...

messages.original:
しんぱいだけど・・・
ほら みんな ちいさいだろ?

高いところや ホウシのなかだと
てが だせないんだよ・・・
messages.translation:
I'm worried, but...
look, they're all small, right?

In high places or inside the spores
they can't reach...

messages.original:
おやっ!
・・・これ、くれるのかい?
うれしいねぇ・・・

そうだ、何かわからないんだけど・・・
かわりに これをもらっとくれ
messages.translation:
Oh!
...You're giving me this?
How nice...

Oh yes, I don't know what it is,
but please take this in return

messages.original:
・・・ふうーーーっ・・・じつは、
おなかの中にガスがたまってて
くるしかったんだよ

おかげで たすかったよ・・・
ありがとうね・・・
そうだ、よくは わからないんだけど

・・・かわりに これをもらっとくれ
・・・めずらしいモノらしいよ
messages.translation:
......Phew...... You see,
gas had built up in my belly
and it was awful

You've saved me......
Thank you......
I don't really understand it, but

......take this in return
......Apparently it's a rare thing

messages.original:
この火、消さない・・・
これ わしのしごと・・・
messages.translation:
I won't let this fire go out...
This is my job...

messages.original:
ん?なんだ、おまえ
これ欲しいのか?

・・・火、あぶないから
きをつけてもっていけ・・・
messages.translation:
Hm? What, you want this? ⏎

...Fire is dangerous,
so be careful carrying it...

messages.original:
お〜い・・・ だれかいないかぁ〜
・・・あかりがきれたぞぉ〜
messages.translation:
Hey... Is anyone there?
...The lights have gone out!

messages.original:
こども!・・・こども見なかったか?

こども、高見ヤグラに 花のたね
さがしにいったまま・・・かえってこない!

しんぱい、しんぱい・・・
とてもしんぱい・・・
messages.translation:
Child!... Have you seen my child?

My child went to the Watch Tower to look for flower seeds
and hasn't come back!

I'm worried, so worried...
Terribly worried...

messages.original:
・・・まだひとりも、
かえってこない・・・
messages.translation: ...Not one of them has come back yet...

messages.original:
・・・あと6人、
かえってこない・・・

・・・あと5人、
かえってこない・・・

・・・あと4人、
かえってこない・・・

・・・あと3人、
かえってこない・・・

・・・あと2人、
かえってこない・・・

・・・あとひとりだけ、
かえってこない・・・

しんぱい、しんぱい・・・
とてもしんぱい・・・
messages.translation:
I'm worried, I'm worried...
I'm very worried...

messages.original:
おお!おまえ、こども、たすけてくれたか!

おまえ、とてもやさしいこころもってる
・・・わし、とてもうれしい

おれいに、これ、もってゆけ、きっとやくにたつ
messages.translation:
Oh! You rescued my child!

You have a very kind heart
...I'm very happy.

As thanks, take this — I'm sure it will help you.

messages.original:
こども見つけてくれて
ありがとう・・・
わしとおまえ、ともだち
messages.translation:
Thank you for finding my child...
You and I are friends.

messages.original:
おにいちゃん、
花のたね みつけたら
おしえてね!
messages.translation: Hey, big brother, if you find flower seeds, let me know!

messages.original:
この花だんにお花咲かせたいなぁ・・・

ちょっと前までは、
森にたくさんの種があったんだよ・・・

でも、今はみんなしおれてた・・・

魔ブタのせいだけじゃないような気がするんだけど・・・
messages.translation:
I want to make flowers bloom in this flowerbed...

Until a little while ago,
there were lots of seeds in the forest...

But now they've all withered...

I get the feeling it isn't only the Evil Pigs' doing, though...

messages.original: もう、お花見れないのかなぁ・・・
messages.translation: I wonder if I'll never see flowers again...

messages.original:
おまえ、APと書かれた
へんなモノ見たか?
messages.translation: Did you see that weird thing with "AP" written on it?

messages.original:
わしらのなかま、あれと同じ
マークの入ったトビラや箱も
見たこと、あるらしい・・・
messages.translation:
Our friends say they've seen
doors and boxes marked
the same as that...

messages.original:
どうすれば、ひらくか?
・・・気になる・・・
messages.translation:
How do I open it?
...I'm curious...

messages.original:
ドワーフ、
とてもこまってる・・・
messages.translation:
The dwarves
are in great trouble...

messages.original:
くわしいはなし、ひろばにいる
なかまがしってる・・・
messages.translation:
My friends in the square
know the details...

messages.original:
おお、おまえ、よくきてくれた!
ドワーフ、とてもこまってる・・・

じつは・・・このドワーフの森、
魔ブタの魔法かかってる・・・
花々はかれ、木々たちも すがた変えた・・・

さっき、4人の なかま、森で しょくぶつに取り込まれ
ゆくえ知れずになった・・・

たぶん、とんがった木の上にくっついた
 ホウシまんじゅうの中か

ぶらさがったホウシダマに取り付かれて
うごけなくなってるハズ・・・

なかま 見つかるまで 森のおくいけないように
してある・・・
おまえ なかま 助けてくれないか・・・
messages.translation:
Oh, you, thank you for coming!
The Dwarves are in great trouble...

The truth is... this Dwarf Forest
is under the Evil Pig's magic...
The flowers withered and the trees changed shape...

Just now, four of our friends were taken by plants in the forest
and went missing...

Probably they're inside a spore bun
stuck on top of a pointed tree,

or caught by a hanging spore ball
and unable to move...

We've made it so no one can go deeper into the forest
until our friends are found...
Will you help our friends...?

messages.original:
たぶん、なかまは とんがった木の上の
 ホウシまんじゅうの中か

ぶらさがったホウシダマに取り付かれて
うごけなくなってるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
Probably our friends are inside a spore bun
on top of a pointed tree,

or caught by a hanging spore ball
and unable to move...

messages.original:
おお!

おまえ・・・なかま、
ぜんいん助けてくれたか・・・

ほんとうに・・・ありがとう・・・
messages.translation:
Oh!

You... you saved
all our friends...

Truly... thank you...

messages.original:
こんかいのバージョンは、ここでおわり・・・
おまえ、もっと プレイしたいなら
ぜひ せいひんばんを あそんでくれ・・・・

なかま たすけてくれた おまえなら
このゲーム きっと たのしいハズ・・・
ドワーフ みんな まってる!!
messages.translation:
This version ends here...
If you want to play more,
please play the final version...

If you saved our friends,
this game will surely be fun for you...
All the Dwarves are waiting!!

messages.original:
・・・7人のなかま、かえってきたけど・・・
じつは、こどもがひとり・・・
森のなかで迷子になったまま・・・
messages.translation:
...Seven companions have returned, but...
Actually, one child is missing...
Still lost in the forest...

messages.original:
おまえ、とても、ゆうきある
ドワーフ、おまえ、そんけいする
messages.translation:
You are very brave.
Dwarf respects you.

messages.original:
勇気ある少年よ・・・
わしがドワーフの
長老ですじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
Brave boy...
I am the Elder
of the Dwarves...

messages.original:
7人のドワーフは
かえってきたんじゃが・・・

子どもがまだ
かえってこないんじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
The seven dwarves have come back,
but...

the child still
hasn't come back...

messages.original:
子どもの父親は、この集落の
入口のちかくの家におる・・・
話をきいてくれんかのぅ・・
messages.translation:
The child's parents are in the house
near the entrance of this settlement...
Won't you go and listen to them?

messages.original:
村人全員になりかわり、
礼を言わせてほしい・・・

なかまをたすけてくれて
本当にありがとう・・・

こんな村じゃから、
たいしたお礼も
できないんじゃが・・・

・・・そうじゃ・・・
100年老人から話は
聞いたんじゃが、

魔ブタのゆくえを
おっているとか・・・
messages.translation:
On behalf of all the villagers,
allow me to thank you...

Thank you so much
for helping our friends...

It's such a small village that
we can't offer you much of a reward...

...Oh, that's right...
I heard from the 100-Year-Old Man,

that you're chasing after the Evil Pigs...

messages.original:
おぉ、あったあった、
これじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
Ah, here it is,
here it is...

messages.original:
これは、この森に魔法をかけた魔ブタの
封印ぶくろ ですじゃ・・・

これがあれば魔ブタのかくれている場所へ近づくだけで、
かくれ場所への入口、すなわち魔ブタゲートを
見つけてくれるハズじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
This is the Seal Bag of the Evil Pig
who cast the spell on this forest...

With this, just by approaching
where an Evil Pig is hiding,
it should find the entrance to the hideout —
the Evil Pig Gate — for you...

messages.original:
でも、魔ブタ、
自分が魔法をかけた場所には
かくれない・・・
messages.translation:
But the Evil Pig
never hides in a place
it has cast its magic on...

messages.original:
それに、魔ブタにはそれぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあり、
1匹づつ封印できる

・・・つまり、7匹の魔ブタに対して
7つの封印ぶくろが必要なわけじゃ
messages.translation:
Also, each Evil Pig has its own Seal Bag,
and you can seal them one at a time.

...In other words, seven Evil Pigs
need seven Seal Bags.

messages.original:
ふくろ、
魔法をかけられた場所の
ちかくに必ずあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The bags should surely be
near the places where the magic was cast...

messages.original:
魔ブタのゆくえを知りたいのなら、
それぞれの 封印ぶくろ をさがすことが
一番の近道じゃろう・・・

しかし・・・魔ブタの力は強大じゃ・・・
ムリはせんようにな・・・

もう、森のおくを見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・
自由に通ってくだされ・・・
messages.translation:
If you want to know where the Evil Pigs are,
finding each Seal Bag
is the quickest way...

But... the Evil Pigs' power is mighty...
Don't push yourself too hard...

There's no need to guard the back of the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...

messages.original:
もう、森のおくを
見はる必要もないじゃろう・・・
自由に通ってくだされ・・・
messages.translation:
There's no need to guard
the back of the forest anymore...
Please feel free to pass through...

messages.original:
魔ブタ・・・
自分が魔法をかけた場所にはかくれない・・・

封印ぶくろあれば
魔ブタゲート見つけることできる・・・

でも、魔ブタには
それぞれに対する封印ぶくろがあって、
1匹づつ封印できる・・・

つまり、7匹の魔ブタに対して
7つの封印ぶくろ ひつよう・・・

ふくろ、魔法をかけられた場所のちかくに
必ずあるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
The Evil Pigs...
never hide in places they cast magic on...

With a Seal Bag,
you can find the Evil Pig Gate...

But each Evil Pig has its own Seal Bag,
and you can seal them one at a time...

In other words, seven Evil Pigs
need seven Seal Bags...

The bags are sure to be
near the places where the magic was cast...

messages.original:
ドワーフ、木を切るのとくい・・・

おまえ、わしら助けてくれた・・・
だからおまえも困ったことあったら、
わしらの なかまにたのむといい・・・
messages.translation:
Dwarves are good at cutting trees...

You helped us...
So if you're ever in trouble,
ask one of our friends...

messages.original:
ん・・・木を切ってほしいのか?

でも、ドワーフが切るのは
やくめをおえた ふるい木だけ・・・

とりあえず、おまえのあとついていく・・・
messages.translation:
Hm... you want a tree cut down?

But dwarves only cut old trees
that have finished their purpose...

Anyway, I'll follow you...

messages.original:
・・・うん、この木ならだいじょうぶ・・・
じゃあ、すこしさがって まってろ・・・
messages.translation:
...Yes, this tree is fine...
Then stand back a little and wait...

messages.original:
おや、あんたも長老をさがしてるのかい?
こまったねぇ・・・

実は、村のドワーフ2人が
ケンカをはじめちやってね・・・
いつもだったら、ほっとくんだけど・・・

よりによって、村の入り口でもみ合ってるから、
外に出られなくなっちゃったんだ・・・

・・・あんた、とめてくれないかい?
messages.translation:
Oh, are you looking for the Elder too?
What a problem...

Actually, two Dwarves of the village
started fighting...
Normally I'd leave them be, but...

Of all places they're scuffling at the village entrance,
so nobody can get outside...

......Could you stop them?

messages.original:
長老がいたら、
一発でおさめてくれるのにねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
If only the Elder were here,
he'd settle it in one go...

messages.original:
うまく かくしたから だいじょうぶ!

そんなの すぐに見つかる・・・

やっぱり、あやまったほうがいい!
messages.translation:
I hid it well, so it's fine!

Something like that will be found right away...

No, I should apologize after all!

messages.original:
何か こわしたとか
なんとか・・・

あの2人、長老から
何かあずかってたらしい・・・
messages.translation: It seems those two received something from Elder...

messages.original:
ほ、ほら・・・やっぱり見つかった!

おまえがわるい!

いや、こわしたのは おまえ!
messages.translation:
S-see... I knew it would be found!

It's your fault!

No, you're the one who broke it!

messages.original:
ぶわっかもーん!!
わしの大事なつぼを
こわすとはなにごとゃ!
messages.translation:
You fool!!
What do you mean by breaking
my precious pot!

messages.original: ご、ごめんなさーい・・・

ふぅ・・・やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・
おまえさん悪いがこの穴をうめといてくれんか?

・・・しかし、だれがこんな穴をほったんじゃろうな・・・

・・・ん?なんじゃ?なんだか外がさわがしいのぉ・・・
ことのついでじゃ
・・・おまえさん ちょっと見てきてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Phew... I finally managed to escape from this hole...
Sorry, but could you please fill this hole back in?

...But who on earth dug this hole anyway...?

...Hmm? What's going on? It's getting noisy outside...
While we're at it... could you go take a look?

messages.original:
ふぅ・・・おまえさんがなかなか来ないから、
いちど村にもどってきたんじゃが、
この穴にみごとにハマってのぉ・・・

やっと穴から抜け出せたわい・・・

・・・おまえさん、
悪いがこの穴をうめといてくれんか?

・・・しかし、だれがこんな穴を
ほったんじゃろうな・・・

わしはまた、山でまっておるからの・・・
あまり、としよりをまたせるでないぞ・・・
messages.translation:
Phew... since you took so long to come,
I came back to the village once,
and fell right into this hole...

I finally got out of the hole...

...Sorry, but could you
fill in this hole for me?

...But who on earth dug such a hole...

I'll be waiting up on the mountain again...
Don't keep an old man waiting too long...

messages.original:
・・・・・・あぁ!お前は!
ぬけ道をふさいじまったガキじゃねえか!

・・・ったく・・・
コマブタ共のすきを見てにげ出そうとしたら、
目の前で出口をふさいじまいやがって・・・

おかげでこの通り、
また ろうやにぎゃく戻りさ・・・
messages.translation:
......Ah! You!
Aren't you the kid who blocked the secret passage!

......Geez......
I was trying to slip away while the Koma Buta weren't looking,
and you blocked the exit right in front of me...

Thanks to that,
I'm back in the dungeon again...

messages.original:
これじゃぁ屋敷の宝物どころか
パン一切れさえぬすめやしねえ・・・

くそっ、ふてねしてやる!
messages.translation:
At this rate I can't steal even a slice of bread,
let alone the mansion's treasure...

Damn it, I'm going to sulk and sleep!

messages.original:
すぴ〜すかかか・・・んがんごっ
・・・すぴょぴょぴょ・・・

おや、かわいいボウヤだね。
でも見たところ元気そうじゃないか・・・

わたしゃこう見えても医者だからね、
ケガでもしたらまたおいで
messages.translation:
Oh, what a cute little boy.
But you look healthy enough, don't you...

I may not look it, but I'm a doctor,
so if you get hurt, come again.

messages.original:
ボウヤ・・・
わたしゃこう見えても
いそがしいんだよ・・・
messages.translation:
Boy...
I know I don't look it,
but I'm busy...

messages.original:
みんなを助けてくれたんだって?
けっこうやるじゃないか・・・ありがとね
messages.translation:
You helped everyone, didn't you?
You're pretty good at this... Thanks.

messages.original:
あんたがケガしたら
まっ先に見てあげるからね
messages.translation:
If you get hurt,
I'll see to you first.

messages.original:
おや、どうしたんだいその小犬・・・
ケガしてるじゃないか!
ちょっと見せてごらん

・・・・・・・・・・
・・・これはちょっとじかんがかかりそうだね・・・

ボウヤ、この小犬しばらく私があずかるよ・・・
なぁに心配はいらないよ、
わたしがせきにんもって みるからさ

・・・あぁ、この犬なんて名前だい?
・・・・?
なんだい・・・名前ぐらい付けてあげなよ・・・

・・・・・・バロン?・・・そうか、バロンか
・・・いい名前じゃないか!
messages.translation:
Oh, what's wrong with that puppy...
It's hurt!
Let me have a look.

..........
...This looks like it will take a while...

Boy, I'll look after this puppy for a while...
Don't worry,
I'll take responsibility for it.

...Oh, what's this puppy's name?
....?
Come on... you could at least give it a name...

......Baron?... I see, Baron.
...That's a good name!

messages.original:
しばらくしたら また、
見に来ておくれ
messages.translation:
Come and see us again
in a while.

messages.original:
おまえ、森の外出るのか?
だったら一度、海辺行ってみるといい

とてもキレイ・・・とおくに大きな屋敷も見える
ウワサでは宝物もあるらしい・・・
おまえ、勇気ある、キョウミあったら行ってみるといい
messages.translation:
You, going outside the forest?
Then go to the seashore once

Very pretty... you can see a big mansion far away
Rumor says there is treasure too...
You, brave. If interested, go and see

messages.original:
・・・そういえば、むかし、
海からこのむらに、魔女きたことある・・・

森にあるふしぎな水晶、魔女のわすれものらしい・・・
たぶん、開けかたは魔女が知ってる・・・
messages.translation:
......Come to think of it, long ago,
a witch came to this village from the sea......

The mysterious crystals in the forest are the Witch's forgotten things......
Probably the Witch knows how to open them......

messages.original:
おまえ、ともだち・・・
またあそびにこい
messages.translation:
You, my friend...
Come play again.

messages.original:
おにいちゃん!おにいちゃん!
・・・お花が咲いたんだよ!
messages.translation:
Big brother! Big brother!
...The flowers have bloomed!

messages.original: わく わく!・・・
キレイだね・・・
・・・楽しみだね

messages.translation:
Gnee gnug glop... gnee gnug
gnu... gruf gnu?

Gnock, grug grub... gnu,
grub gruu glub

messages.original: た○へ○だ!た○へ○だぁ!
た○へ○だ!た○へ○だぁ!
たいへんだ!たいへんだぁ!
たいへんだ!たいへんだぁ!

messages.translation:
Gnock, gnub gnock...
gnug glop grug...

messages.original:
そ○の◎◎の◎◎・・・◎◎に
つな○△てる・・・もう◎△たか?
messages.translation:
Gruu glub grup... grup
gnock gnee... gnug glop?

In the forest, I saw a strange dog...
Did you see it?

messages.original:
◎のまえ●、◎◎
いなくな△た・・・

な○とか ひ△しで
◎●てきた・・・
○や、か○いい□□□だね・・・
ね△、◎△て○いいでし△・・・
◎の◎はあ●ないよ・・・
わ○ら、○ても◎△て○
わ○ら、○ても◎△て○
な○まの○と・・・とても○ん◎い
messages.translation:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.

messages.original:
な○まの○と・・・
と○も○ん◎い
messages.translation:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.

messages.original: ねぇ、行ってもいいでしょ・・・

森の中、とてもあぶない
・・・ぜったいダメ!
messages.translation:
It's very dangerous in the forest
...absolutely not!

messages.original:
そこの右側の入口・・・
長老の家につながってる

・・・でも、今みんな
いそがしい・・・
messages.translation:
The entrance on the right side over there...
It's connected to Elder's house.

...But everyone's busy right now...

messages.original:
おおっ! コトバ少し おぼえたか・・・
でも、まだ かんぜんには わからない

・・・あと、ひとりに かみつけば
たぶんコトバおぼえられる・・・
messages.translation:
Oh! You've learned a little of our language...
But I still don't understand you completely.

...If you bite one more,
you can probably learn the language...

messages.original:
ここ、ドワーフの村
・・・なかまいなくなって
おおさわぎ・・・
messages.translation:
This is the Dwarf Village...
our friends have gone missing,
and it's a big uproar...

messages.original:
たいへん!たいへん!
なかま、いなくなった!

森にある小屋はとじてあるから
なかま きっと このもりの
どこかに いるはず・・・
messages.translation:
Oh no! Oh no!
Our friends are gone!

The hut in the forest is shut,
so our friends must be
somewhere in this forest...

messages.original:
目のまえで、なかま
いなくなった・・・
messages.translation:
Right before my eyes, my friend
disappeared...

messages.original:
なかま、木にとりついた
ホウシにつかまって
木にぶらさがってた・・・

ぶらさがると のびるホウシダマ
・・・とても あやしい・・・
messages.translation:
A friend was caught by a spore
that attached itself to a tree,
and was hanging from the tree...

The Spore Balls stretch when you hang from them
...very suspicious...

messages.original:
このへんなキカイ、
昔からここにある・・・
わしらには動かせない・・・
messages.translation:
This strange machine
has been here since long ago......
We can't move it......

messages.original: わし・・・長老のいちばんでし
messages.translation: I... am the Elder's top disciple

messages.original:
なんとか ひっしで
にげてきた・・・

なかまのこと・・・
とてもしんぱい
messages.translation:
About my friends...
I'm very worried.

messages.original:
たいへん!たいへん!
何がたいへんって、
そりゃーもーたいへん!
messages.translation:
Terrible! Terrible!
What's so terrible?
It's just awfully terrible!

messages.original:
みんなのこと・・・
とてもしんぱい

封印ぶくろ?・・・そういえば、
森の封印ぶくろとかいうもの
ちょうろうがもってる・・・
messages.translation:
Seal Bag?... Come to think of it,
the Elder has something called
the Forest Seal Bag...

messages.original:
おまえ、友だち・・・
まぁ、ゆっくりしていけ
messages.translation:
You, friend...
Well, make yourself at home.

messages.original:
かれはのなかに
かわったチョウチョがいるらしい・・・

おまえ見たこと あるか?
messages.translation:
There's apparently a strange butterfly
among the dead leaves...

Have you ever seen it?

messages.original:
あのイヌ、
ケガしてたんだってな・・・
messages.translation: I heard that dog was injured...

messages.original:
ぶらさがっている まるい
ホウシダマ 見なかったか?
messages.translation:
Did you see a round, hanging
spore ball?

messages.original:
森の中にある恵みの広場
・・・もう行ったか?
messages.translation:
The Megumi Plaza in the forest
......Have you been there yet?

messages.original:
なかまのこと
とてもしんぱい
messages.translation:
I'm so worried
about our friends

messages.original:
わし・・・見はり・・・ん?何の見はりか?
・・・・・それはおしえられない・・・
messages.translation:
I...... watch...... Hm? Watching what?
......That I cannot tell you......

messages.original: 長老にはもうあったか?
messages.translation: Have you met the Elder yet?

messages.original:
なかま たすけてくれた
・・・ありがとう

そう言えば・・・
始まりの森のかみつき草にも
花が咲くらしい・・・

でも、わしら見たことない・・・
messages.translation:
Speaking of which...
they say flowers bloom on the Biting Grass
in the Forest of Beginnings too...

But we've never seen it...

messages.original:
キノコの森を右側にぬけた先に
山がある・・・でも、
とてもキケンな山・・・
messages.translation:
Beyond the Mushroom Forest, to the right,
there's a mountain... but
it's a very dangerous mountain...

messages.original:
キノコの森には、
いろんなキノコはえてるけど
むやみに食べない方がいい
messages.translation: There are various mushrooms growing in the Mushroom Forest, but you shouldn't eat them recklessly.

messages.original:
高見ヤグラのぼうえんきょう、もう見たか?
あそこのけしき、とてもキレイ・・・
messages.translation:
Have you seen the Watch Tower's telescope yet?
The view from there is really beautiful...

messages.original:
このキカイこわれてる・・・

たまに来る、赤い服をきたヤツなら
なおせるかもしれない
messages.translation:
This machine is broken......

Someone who comes by sometimes, in red clothes,
might be able to fix it

messages.original:
わし・・・見はり・・・
ちょっとたいへん・・・
messages.translation:
I... I'm a lookout...
It's a little difficult...

messages.original:
わしらの◎◎、いなくな△た・・・
◎は◎に◎ないほう●いい・・・
messages.translation:
Gnu gnub, gnock gnee...
grup gruf gnu gnub...

messages.original: わしらの◎◎にはもう◎△たか?
messages.translation: Have you met our Elder yet?

messages.original:
わしらのなかま、いなくなった・・・
今は森に出ないほうがいい・・・
messages.translation:
Our comrades have disappeared...
It's better not to go into the forest now...

messages.original: わしらの長老にはもう会ったか?
messages.translation: Have you met our Elder yet?

messages.original:
たき火といえば・・・
・・・・・・ヤキイモだねぇ・・・

そういえば、
森の中でいいニオイがするんだけどねぇ・・・
messages.translation:
Speaking of bonfires...
...it's baked sweet potatoes, isn't it...

Come to think of it, there's a nice smell in the forest...

messages.original:
おやっ!
・・・これ、くれるのかい?
うれしいねぇ・・・

そうだ、何かわからないんだけど・・・
かわりに これをもらっとくれ
messages.translation:
Oh!
...You're giving me this?
How nice...

Oh yes, I don't know what it is,
but please take this in return

messages.original:
ケガしてるね・・・
かわいそう・・・
messages.translation:
You're hurt, aren't you...
Poor thing...

messages.original:
とがった木にぶら下がっている
ホウシまんじゅう・・・ぜんぶ見たか?
messages.translation:
Have you checked all the spore buns
hanging from the pointed trees?

messages.original:
とがった木にぶら下がっている
ホウシまんじゅうの中に
なかま2人 とりこまれた
messages.translation:
Two friends got caught
in the spore buns
hanging from the pointed trees

messages.original:
ユラユラゆれるホウシダマ・・・
とてもあやしい・・・
messages.translation:
The swaying Spore Balls...
very suspicious...

messages.original:
ホウシダマがかぶさっている
木の上のなかま、2人いるハズ・・・
messages.translation:
There should be two friends
up in the trees covered by Spore Balls...

messages.original:
グラグラさんばしに なかまひとり
つかまってた・・・
messages.translation:
One friend was caught
at Wobbly Pier...

messages.original:
高見ヤグラ・・・ひろくてたいへん
・・・なかま見つけにくい・・・
回復する板、うまくつかわないと・・・
messages.translation:
The Watch Tower...... is wide and hard
......hard to find friends......
If you don't use the healing boards well......

messages.original:
たしか高見ヤグラに2人のなかま
つかまっているハズ
messages.translation: I think there are two companions trapped in Watch Tower.

messages.original: CLEAR!
ドワーフの長老
コトバを吸いとろう!
たき火といえば…
伝説のカレハチョウ
火が消えちゃった…
まいごのドワーフ
花のたね
AP・ピラー
ドワーフを数え
タルのゆくえ
森の封印ぶくろ
花の森
かみつき草の花
ドワーフの助け
魔女の忘れもの
見えないカガミ?
messages.translation: The Mirror You Can't See In?

messages.original: ケンカをとめて
地下ロウの大ドロボウ
messages.translation: The Great Thief of the Underground Prison

messages.original: のぞいてごらん?!
ヨ〜イ…ドン!
バロンは友だち
これ、な〜んだ?
やしきの宝物?
水晶のじゅもん
とびっきりの笑がお!
とびっきりの泣きがお?
動かない恵みコゾウ
怪物?勝てるかな?
死神の巣をつぶせ
カギがかかっている
ヒヨコをつかった
カエルをつかった
バナナをつかった
あばれ竜巻をつかった
100年のカギをつかった
100年の鍵をつかった
めぐみの羽根をつかった
かみつき草の花をつかった
マゴブタをつかった
ケモノダッシュ
カエルがにげた

奥のカベには ↑と×ボタンで とびつくことができ、
そのまま上に上がると 奥のラインを歩けるよ
手前にもどりたいときはその逆だよ
messages.translation: You can jump onto the wall in the back with ↑ and the × button, and if you keep going up you can walk along the back line. To come back to the front, do the opposite.

messages.original:
木の枝にぶら下がったときは→で回転
どんどん速くなる。ジャンプしたい
方向と×ボタンで飛び出す!
messages.translation: When you hang from a tree branch, press → to spin. You go faster and faster. Press the direction you want to jump and the × button to launch yourself off!

messages.original:
○ボタンをおしつづけると、
より強力な攻撃ができる
messages.translation: Hold down the ○ button for a more powerful attack.

messages.original: 人と話すときは ○ボタン
messages.translation: When talking to people, press the ○ button.

messages.original:
ここがセーブポイントです。
↑で奥を向いているときに
○を押せばセーブができます
messages.translation: This is a save point. Face into the screen with ↑ and press ○ to save.

messages.original: ポスト あけるな!
始まりの村
始まりの森
100年老人の小屋
ふるいけ

この土地は はじめてか?

オレは前に ここに住んでたんだけど、
なんか ようすがかわっちまってよォ

なんかわからんが、しりたいことがあるなら
この先の ずーっと上の小屋に住んでる

100年老人というジィさんに
会ってきいてみろよ

でも、このあたりもあぶなくなったから
気ィつけていけよ

あっ そうだ! たてふだは見てけよ
見るときは ↑と○ボタンだぜ

・・・じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Is this your first time on this land?

I used to live here, but things seem to have changed somehow.

I don't know what's going on, but if there's something you want to know, there's a cabin way up ahead —

an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there. Go meet him and ask.

But it's gotten dangerous around here too, so be careful.

Oh, right! Be sure to read the signpost. Press ↑ and the ○ button to read it.

...See you!

messages.original:
よぉ、にィちゃんも
この先に行きたいのかい?

そりゃぁムリだ・・・
この先はキリで まっ白だぜ

キリがなくなりゃぁ
行けるんだけどな・・・
messages.translation:
Hey, you want to go on up ahead too, pal?

That's impossible... It's pure white with fog up there.

If the fog cleared you could go, but...

messages.original:
まぁーきくところによると あばれ竜巻 があれば
何とかなるみたいだけど・・・
じっさい どこにあるんだよ、そんなもん・・・

オレは あきらめた!
にぃちゃんも考えた方がいいぜ・・・

あばよ!
messages.translation:
From what I hear, if you had a Rampaging Tornado you could manage somehow...
But where on earth would a thing like that be...?

I gave up!
You'd better think about it too, pal...

So long!

messages.original: ちょっと まてよ
ウワッ!やめろョ

オレは今、ハラがへってて イライラしてんだ
何か たべるもん ないか?・・・
なけりゃ またあとにしてくれョ
messages.translation:
I'm starving and in a foul mood right now.
Got anything to eat?...
If not, come back later.

messages.original:
オ〜〜〜ッ!
なんだ それくれるのか?

サンキュー! たすかったゼ
もう ハラがへって、うごけなかったんだ

オレ サンタ ってんだ、よろしくな
messages.translation:
Ohhh!
What, you're giving me that?

Thanks! You saved me!
I was so hungry I couldn't move.

I'm Santa. Nice to meet you.

messages.original:
そうだ!!
とっておきの技をおしえてやるョ

いいか?
messages.translation:
That's it!!
I'll teach you a special move.

Ready?

messages.original:
□ボタンを押しながら走るとスピードが速くなる、
人よんで ケモノダッシュっていう技だゼ
messages.translation:
Run while holding the □ button and you go faster.
It's a move people call the Beast Dash.

messages.original:
おぼえたか?
□ボタンを押しながらだぞ・・・・・・
じゃぁオレはいくゼ

あばよ!
messages.translation:
Got it?
Remember, hold the □ button......
Well, I'm off.

So long!

messages.original: サンキュ
バイバイ・・・

・・・あらら・・・もう見つかっちゃった!

かくれてたんだけど よくわかったな・・・
messages.translation:
...Aw... you found me already!

I was hiding, and you still figured it out...

messages.original:
よし! いいことおしえてやるよ

この小屋のウラをまっすぐ奥に行くと ふるいけ、
そして、この小屋の先を上に行くと
100年老人っていう ジィさんが住んでるんだ
messages.translation:
Alright! I'll tell you something good.

Go straight back behind this hut and you'll come to the Old Pond,
and if you go up past this hut,
an old man called the 100-Year-Old Man lives there.

messages.original:
え?・・・オイラかい?・・・・・・
そんなことより まず行ってみろよ、
ウソじゃないから・・・

そのあとで また会おうや
messages.translation:
Huh? ...Me?...
Never mind that, go and see for yourself first,
I'm not lying...

We'll meet again after that.

messages.original: えっ?!もう行ったのか?・・・そうか・・・
messages.translation: What?! You've already been there?... I see...

messages.original:
100年老人には会ったのかい?

会ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you met the 100-Year-Old Man?

Once you have, come see me again.

messages.original:
ふるいけ には行ったかい?

行ったら また会おうや
messages.translation:
Have you been to the Old Pond?

Once you have, come see me again.

messages.original:
どうだい、ウソじゃなかっただろ

じまんじゃないけどオイラいろいろ しってんだ
messages.translation:
See, I wasn't lying, was I?

Not to brag, but I know all kinds of things.

messages.original:
・・・あぁ、オイラかい?

オイラ、ヤン かくれ里のヤンていうんだ・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh, me?

I'm Yan. Yan of the Hidden Village...

messages.original:
いつも かくれてるんだけど、
だれも見つけられないんだ・・・

また見つけられたら そのときも
いいことおしえてやるよ!
・・・見つけることができたらな
messages.translation:
I'm always hiding, but nobody can ever find me...

If you find me again, I'll tell you something good then too!
...If you can find me, that is.

messages.original:
う〜ん・・・なんだか楽しくなってきたな・・・
がんばって見つけてくれよ

じゃあな!
messages.translation:
Hmm... this is starting to be fun...
Do your best to find me!

See ya!

messages.original:
この先に行く気か?

でも・・・おまえ泳げるんかィ?
messages.translation:
You're thinking of going on ahead?

But... can you swim?

messages.original:
いかん、いかん

今はカメさんに たすけてもらったが
次からそうはいかん

そこのトビラの先は
泳げないと行けんのだから・・・

悪いことはいわん、
今はやめた方がいい・・・

いつか 泳げるようになってから行くんだナ

おっ そうだ!
おまえ ハラへってないかィ?

これ もってけよ!
messages.translation:
No, no.

A turtle helped you this time, but it won't go like that next time.

You can't go past that door unless you can swim, so...

I'm not saying this to be mean, but you'd better not go now...

Go when you've learned to swim someday, all right?

Oh, right!
Aren't you hungry?

Take this!

messages.original: じゃあなボウズ 気ィつけて行けや
messages.translation: See you, kid. Be careful out there.

messages.original:
・・・うーん・・・こまったのォ・・・

どーしたもんかのォ・・・

んっ?
messages.translation:
...Hmm... what a problem...

Whatever shall I do...

Oh?

messages.original:
なんじゃ?・・・
わしが100年老人じゃが・・・何か用かな?
messages.translation:
What is it?...
I'm the 100-Year-Old Man... Do you need something?

messages.original:
すまんが、ちょっと
考えごとをしておってな・・・・・・

・・・おお そうじゃ!!
ちょっと おまえさん、たのまれてくれんか?
たのみというのはのォ・・・

おまえさんも ここへ来るとき 見たと思うが、
赤いトリのコッカのやつめ、

よそからタマゴを盗んできては、
ああやって自分のものにしておってな・・・

あのままでは
中のヒナが かわいそうなんじゃ・・・

そこでおまえさん、このへんにあるタマゴの中にいる
ヒナを全部 集めてくれんか?
messages.translation:
Sorry, I was lost in thought...

...Oh, that's right!!
Would you do me a favor?
The favor is, you see...

You must have seen it on your way here —
that red bird, Kokka...

It steals eggs from other places
and keeps them as its own...

Left like that,
the chicks inside will suffer...

So, would you gather all the chicks from the eggs around here?

messages.original:
しんぱいじゃからな・・・
たのんだぞ
messages.translation:
I'm worried about them...
I'm counting on you.

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか?

ん〜〜〜っ・・・
じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・

すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
What, you've already collected them?

Hmmmm...
But it seems some are still left...

Sorry, but could you go once more?

messages.original:
集めてくれたのか?・・・
ん〜〜〜っ・・・

じゃが まだ残っとるようじゃのォ・・・
すまんがもう一度 行ってくれんか?
messages.translation:
Did you collect them?...
Hmmmmmmm...

But it seems there are still some left...
Sorry, but could you go again?

messages.original:
なんじゃ、もう 集まっとるのか・・・
おおぉぉぉっ!しかも全部集まっとるではないか!
・・・・・・で、中身はどこじゃ?
messages.translation:
What, they've already been gathered...?
Oh my! And you even got all of them!
......But where are the chicks?

messages.original:
おー・まい・がっ!!

ハラの中に入れとったのか!?

まぁ、しかし 消化はされとらんようじゃし、
よしとするかのォ

いやぁ、何はともあれ ごくろうじゃった
・・・これで わしも安心じゃわい

んっ?・・・・・・そうじゃそうじゃ
わしに何か用が あったようじゃな

・・・・・・ほう・・・・・・
コマブタに おジィさんの形見のうでわを
とられたのか・・・

それで コマブタたちのことを
ききたいんじゃな・・・

んっ わかった・・・
じつはのォ・・・・・・・・・・・・
messages.translation:
Oh... my... god!!

You kept them in your stomach!?

Well, they don't seem to have been digested, so I suppose it's fine...

Anyway, thank you for your trouble.
...Now I can rest easy.

Hm?... Oh yes, yes.
You seem to have had some business with me.

......Hoh......
The Koma Buta took your grandfather's keepsake bracelet...?

So you want to ask about the Koma Buta...

Hm, I see...
The truth is...

messages.original:
集めてくれたのか?

・・・おぉっ!! 全部集まったようじゃな
・・・・・・で、中身はどこじゃ?
messages.translation:
Did you collect them?

...Oh!! It seems you've gathered them all.
......But where are the chicks?

messages.original:
わしが話してやれる事はここまでじゃ・・・

もしおまえさんがこの先の道を進むのなら、
わしの仲間をさがしてみるといい、
きっと力になってくれるはずじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
That's as far as I can tell you...

If you go on down the road ahead,
try looking for my friends.
They're sure to help you...

messages.original:
もちろん、わしの力になれることじゃったら
何でも協力してやるからの・・・

・・・そうじゃ、

わしは物の めききには自信があるから、
使い道のわからない物を手に入れたら
わしのところに持ってくるといい・・・
messages.translation:
Of course, anything I can do to help,
I'll gladly lend a hand...

...That's right,

I have a good eye for things,
so if you get something
you don't know how to use,
bring it to me...

messages.original:
おや?ないのぉ・・・
おまえさんに100年のすずを
やろうとおもったんじゃが・・・

どこかで無くしてしまったようじゃな・・・

もし、それらしい物をみつけたら
持ってきておくれ・・・

そのかわり、おまえさんには・・・
ホレ、これをやろう・・・100年のカギじゃ
messages.translation:
Oh? It's gone...
I meant to give you the 100-Year Bell,
but...

It seems I lost it somewhere...

If you find something that looks like it,
bring it to me...

In exchange, I'll give you this...
Here, take this — the 100-Year Key.

messages.original:
これで、ここにあるのとおなじ宝箱なら
あけることができるようになったはずじゃ・・・
ん〜ラッキーじゃのぉ・・・
messages.translation:
With this, you should now be able to open treasure chests just like the ones here...
Hmm, what luck...

messages.original:
それと・・・魔ブタをさがすには、
封印ぶくろ と呼ばれるモノが必要じゃ・・・

それがないと、
かくれ場所が目に見えんようになっとるんじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
And... to find the Evil Pigs,
you'll need something called a Seal Bag...

Without it,
their hiding places can't be seen...

messages.original:
封印ぶくろのことは、この先の森に住む
ドワーフの長老にきいてみるといい・・・
もっとくわしくおしえてくれるはずじゃ。
messages.translation:
As for the Seal Bag, ask the Dwarf Elder
who lives in the forest ahead...
He should be able to tell you more.

messages.original: なんじゃ、わからない物があるなら見せてごらん・・・
messages.translation: What's this? If there's something you don't understand, show it to me...

messages.original:
・・・おおっ、これはまさしく100年のすず!
よく見つけたのぉ・・・

これをつかえばいつでも、
ここに戻って来ることができるはずじゃ・・・
messages.translation:
...Oh, this is indeed the 100-Year Bell!
Well done finding it...

If you use this,
you should be able to come back here any time...

messages.original: CLEAR!
ジィちゃんの形見
100年老人との出会い
霧を吹き飛ばせ!
カエル水にかえる
messages.translation: The frog returns to the water.

messages.original: モトクロスコース
キミ、だあれ?
大きな水たまり?
かくれ里のヤン
オイラ泳げない…
コッカタマゴの中身
100年老人の話
ドワーフの長老
サルの好きなもの…
小さなブタ…マゴブタ?
